```text
FQHESphereFermionsWithSpin, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereFermionsWithSpin [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 5)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (default value = 8)
    -s, --total-sz : twice the z component of the total spin of the system (default value = 0)
    --lzsymmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --szsymmetrized-basis : use Sz <-> -Sz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-sz=0)
    --minus-szparity : select the  Sz <-> -Sz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --minus-lzparity : select the  Lz <-> -Lz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --nbrspin-polarized : number of orbitals which ar fully spin up polarized (from the one with the lowest momentum) (default value = 0)
    --all-sz : use Hilbert-space with all values of sz
    --gutzwiller : use Gutzwiller projection in orbital space (i.e., no double occupation in orbital space)
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state
    --nbr-chebyshev : number of times H acts on a vector) (default value = 0)
    --input-file : file describing the input vector
    --energy-min : lowest energy in the spectrum (default value = 0)
    --energy-max : highest energy in the spectrum (default value = 0)
    --chemical-potential : chemical potential shift, H -> H + mu (default value = 0)
    --chebyshev-epsilon : epsilon parameter for Chebyshev (default value = 0)
    --l2-factor : multiplicative factor in front of an optional L^2 operator than can be added to the Hamiltonian (default value = 0)
    --s2-factor : multiplicative factor in front of an optional S^2 operator than can be added to the Hamiltonian (default value = 0)
    --initial-lz : twice the inital momentum projection for the system (default value = 0)
    --nbr-lz : number of lz value to evaluate (default value = -1)
    --interaction-file : file describing the 2-body interaction in terms of the pseudo-potential
    --interaction-name : interaction name (as it should appear in output files)
    --use-hilbert : name of the file that contains the vector files used to describe the reduced Hilbert space (replace the n-body basis)
    --get-hvalue : compute mean value of the Hamiltonian against each eigenstate

precalculation options:
    --fast-search : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast state search (in Mbytes) (default value = 9)
    --save-hilbert : save Hilbert space description in the indicated file and exit (only available for the haldane or symmetrized bases)
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the haldane or symmetrized bases)
    -m, --memory : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast multiplication (in Mbytes) (default value = 0)
    --s2-memory : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast multiplication of s2 term (in Mbytes) (default value = 500)
    --l2-memory : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast multiplication of l2 term (in Mbytes) (default value = 500)
    --allow-disk-storage : expand memory for fast multiplication using disk storage
    --load-precalculation : load precalculation from a file
    --save-precalculation : save precalculation in a file

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

Lanczos options:
    -n, --nbr-eigen : number of eigenvalues (default value = 30)
    --full-diag : maximum Hilbert space dimension for which full diagonalization is applied (value must be greater than 100, default value = 500)
    --iter-max : maximum number of lanczos iteration (default value = 3000)
    --block-lanczos : use block Lanczos algorithm
    --block-size : size of the block used in the block Lanczos algorithm (default value = 2)
    --limit-time : use limit in time instead of a number of lanczos iteration (0 if none, time in seconds) (default value = 0)
    -d, --disk : enable disk resume capabilities
    -r, --resume : resume from disk datas
    --nbr-iter : number of lanczos iteration (for the current run) (default value = 10)
    --nbr-vector : maximum number of vector in RAM during Lanczos iteration (default value = 10)
    --force-reorthogonalize : force to use Lanczos algorithm with reorthogonalizion even if the number of eigenvalues to evaluate is 1
    --eigenstate : evaluate eigenstates
    --eigenstate-convergence : evaluate Lanczos convergence from eigenstate convergence
    --show-itertime : show time spent for each Lanczos iteration
    --initial-vector : use file as the initial vector for the Lanczos algorithm
    --partial-lanczos : only run a given number of Lanczos iterations
    --lanczos-precision : define Lanczos precision for eigenvalues (0 if automatically defined by the program) (default value = 0)
    --fast-disk : use disk storage to increase speed of ground state calculation and decrease memory footprint when using Lanczos algorithm
    --resume-fastdisk : resume the fast-disk mode Lanczos algorithm from a stopped one (for example due to computer crash)
    --project-l2 : add a projector onto the L2 groundstate
    --project-s2 : add a projector onto the S2 groundstate
    --project-l2-s2 : add a projector onto the common groundstate of L2+S2
    --projector-storage : additional number of vectors in RAM when using projected Lanczos (default value = 2)
    --projector-iter-max : maximum number of iterations for internal lanczos (default value = 100)
    --projector-precision : define Lanczos precision for projection (0 if automatically defined by the program) (default value = 1e-14)
    --restart-projection : allow lanczos projections to be restarted if full convergence not yet reached

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries
    --show-hamiltonian : show matrix representation of the hamiltonian

misc options:
    --energy-expectation : name of the file containing the state vector, whose energy expectation value shall be calculated
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
```
